title: Freaky Ali
desc: After a chance encounter with a golfer inspires him, Ali, a debt collector working for a gangster, pursues the sport professionally. Soon, he becomes a champion, but he must face a corrupt rival.

title: Provoked
desc: A Punjabi woman, who was abused by her husband for 10 years. After killing her husband in self-defense, Ahluwalia is imprisoned as those close to her fight to set her free.

title: Kabir Singh
desc: An exalted but short-fused surgeon plunges into a spiral of drugs, alcohol and rage after his intense relationship with his girlfriend turbulently ends.

title: Happy Ending
desc: Yudi is suffering from writer's block and his publishers decide to stop supporting him and instead publish the work of an Indian bestselling author. So, he must do something soon to maintain his fame.

title: Toonpur Ka Superr Hero
desc: The world is in chaos as there is a constant quarrel between Devtoons, good cartoons, and Toonasurs, bad cartoons. Thereafter, Devtoons decide to abduct Aditya, a superhero, to save them.
